elena: Hey team — quick agenda for tomorrow's all-hands (Thu Jul 12, 10:00 PT). Items:
- Exec updates (Elena) — 10m
- Product launch recap + learnings (Matt) — 12m
- Dedicated perf improvements demo (Matt/Sanjay) — 7m
- Data retention policy update (Maria) — 8m
- Q&A / open floor — 15m
Please drop any questions below you want covered. If private, DM me or post in #help. Recording will be posted after the meeting. :calendar:

matt: Can we add a 2-slide appendix on model routing fallback behavior? I can do that.

elena: yes, add it after the product recap. good call.

sanjay: Ops note: we'll be doing a canary deploy during the week of Jul 17. I'll include the rollout windows in the pre-read.

rachel: Maria — will the data retention change affect Dedicated and Private customers by default?

maria: Short answer: hosted customers will see the default retention change; Dedicated/Private will get config flags and an opt-in migration. Full legal/ops guidance in the doc below.

maria: pre-read: https://internal.redwood/docs/data-retention-policy-july-2026 (internal) — please scan before the meeting.

elena: thanks. If folks want to raise questions in advance, list them here so we can slot answers into the slides.

devin: Q: will old embeddings be reprocessed under new retention rules or just deleted?

maria: We'll not reprocess automatically. Customers can request a migration window; otherwise data older than X days will be purged per the policy.

ops-bot: Calendar invite created: All-Hands — Thu Jul 12 10:00 PT. Invite link: https://calendar.redwood/events/abcd1234

dan: Can we add a brief segment at the end (~3m) for growth highlights? Good momentum to share.

elena: added. final agenda updated. I'll post the slide deck link 30m before the meeting. Recording + transcript will be posted to this thread after.

rachel: Slide deck draft: https://drive.redwood/sheets/allhands-july12 (view only)

matt: I'll bring the perf metrics and a short demo clip (30s) of the new KV cache improvements.

sanjay: ACTION: I'll prepare the rollout calendar and ping eng-oncall for overlap windows. @ops-bot please add 'canary-week' tag.

ops-bot: Tag added: #canary-week

elena: thanks everyone. if no other questions, please review the pre-reads. See you tomorrow. :wave:

maria: FYI legal will prepare an FAQ for customer-facing comms; will share draft by EOD Wed.
